title: krypton-umbrella-slim values
description: Validates the slim umbrella's own keys, most importantly the global block that krypton-lib-slim reads. The krypton-* blocks are left permissive on purpose: the slim variant ships no per-subchart schemas; unknown component keys under syncWaves/syncOptions are still caught at render time by the library's component catalog.

laneName.description: Lane/environment name; part of every resource name (<subchart>-<lane>[-<instance>], shared resources omit it) and the app.kubernetes.io/part-of label.

partOfPrefix.description: Optional prefix for the app.kubernetes.io/part-of label: <partOfPrefix>-<laneName> (e.g. krypton-umbrella-slim -> krypton-umbrella-slim-release). Empty stamps the bare lane name.

labelDomain.description: Domain prefix for the generated <domain>/source-chart annotation; defaults to krypton.io.

krypton-lib-slim.description: Injected by Helm for the declared library dependency; carries no values.

stringMap.description: Label/annotation map; values must be strings.

componentType.description: Component-type key. Membership in the platform catalog is enforced at render time by krypton-lib-slim.componentCatalog; the schema only checks the shape.

syncOption.description: One ArgoCD resource-level sync option, e.g. Prune=false, Delete=false, Replace=true, SkipDryRunOnMissingResource=true.

subchartBlock.description: Only the keys the slim library reads are typed here; everything else belongs to the subchart and passes through.

jenkins.description: CI-injected block. jenkins.annotations is merged into every resource's annotations of this subchart when present; other keys are left to the pipeline.

annotations.description: Annotation map; scalar values are stringified at render time, so a numeric build id from --set is fine.
